svg.aria-label: 1. Open the latest release: From your phone, on this repository's Releases page.; 2. Download the APK: Tap pawdori-<version>.apk: it is about 28 MB.; 3. Allow the install: Android asks to trust this source: allow it for Pawdori only.; 4. Adopt your pet: Open Pawdori, create your account and pick your new best friend.
